checks: Confirm the review window (2026-09-01 to 2026-11-30) and the last IDT review date; pull all encounters, notes, and orders dated inside the window.
Falls and near-falls: search nursing, therapy, and incident notes for falls, injuries, or unsteadiness, especially with chronic knee osteoarthritis and chronic back pain.
ED visits and hospital admissions or observation stays in the window, including discharge summaries and whether any follow-up visit occurred.

Medication starts and stops since last review. Specifically review ibuprofen 400 mg (started 2026-07-05) in light of ischemic heart disease, concurrent clopidogrel, and metoprolol: check for GI bleeding signs, bleeding or bruising, BP and renal function labs, and whether prescriber and indication are documented.

Chronic pain management: pain scores over the window, opioid or other analgesic use, PRN frequency, and any signs of misuse or escalation given the documented history of dependent drug abuse. Check PDMP or pharmacy records if available and per policy.
Cardiac status: chest pain or nitroglycerin spray use frequency, BP and heart rate trend on metoprolol, and any lipid or cardiology follow-up due for simvastatin and clopidogrel therapy.
Sleep apnea and sleep disorder: CPAP or device adherence data, sleep complaints, daytime sedation, and any changes in sedating medications.
Weight and BMI trend (obesity, knee OA mobility limits): compare current weight with prior values and note any unintended change.
Function and ADLs: compare current ADL and IADL status, mobility aids, and therapy referrals with the last review; note any decline.

Cognition, mood, and attendance: screen notes for cognitive change, depression or anxiety signs, social isolation, and missed PACE center days or appointments; check caregiver or support situation and any reported strain or changes at home. Also confirm open care-plan items due in the window (assessments, reassessments, and care-plan updates).
